identity.name: Cascade Lakes
identity.notes: 55+ gated active adult community of 600 single-family homes in Boynton Beach, FL (ZIP 33437/33426), built 2000-2002. Located between West Palm Beach and Boca Raton on Military Trail, south of Woolbright Road. Homes are set adjacent to eight scenic lakes. Price range: high $300ks to mid $600ks. Resale homes only.

fees.note: Range $555-$636/month depending on property. hoa-agent.com reports $636/mo as observed range; 55places.com reports $268-$636/mo. One-time capital contribution of ~$1,665 (one quarter of monthly dues) applies at closing. No special assessments reported. Verify with association directly.
One-time capital contribution equal to one quarter of monthly HOA dues, due at closing.

Reported range $555-$636/month depending on property; hoa-agent.com lists $636/mo. Self-managed HOA (Cascade Lakes Residents Association, Inc.). Exact current fee schedule not published on official HOA site; confirm with HOA at (561) 737-9986 before purchase. No CDD assessment found in sources checked (community may not have a CDD). One-time capital contribution at closing equal to one quarter of monthly dues (around $1,665) applies per same source. Leasing prohibited in first year of ownership and requires HOA approval thereafter; commercial vehicles, RVs, and boats prohibited (per same source). Clubhouse closed for renovations as of Sept 2026 per same source - may affect amenity access/fees context. MLS-verified closed sales trailing 12 months: 33 sales ranging $270,000-$633,000 (as of Sept 2026) per palmbeachcountyhomeforsale.com guide. 24/7 manned guard gate controls access per same guide. 55+ age restriction enforced. Pet policy: up to two pets, 25-lb weight limit, aggressive-breed restrictions (per hoabulletinboard). Homes: 600 single-family, 1,525-3,206 sq ft, built 2000-2002, three collections (Classic/Grand/Premier), all single-story, adjacent to 8 lakes. Distinct from nearby 'The Cascades' (928 homes off Jog Road) - do not conflate. HOA address: 5075 Cascade Lakes Blvd, Boynton Beach, FL 33437; website cascadelakeshoa.net. Location: Military Trail, south of Woolbright Rd, between West Palm Beach and Boca Raton. Price range per buyer notes: high $300ks to mid $600ks, resale only. Amenities: 28,000 sq ft clubhouse (library with computers, card room, billiards, arts & crafts studio, ballroom with stage, fully-equipped fitness center, aerobics room, saunas), indoor-outdoor resort-style pool and spa, 7 lighted Har-Tru tennis courts, pickleball courts, bocce courts, walking and biking trails around 8 lakes. Country-club-style amenities without equity/membership fees. Strong resident club/event culture per hoabulletinboard. Proximity: near beaches, golf, shopping, major highways per hoabulletinboard (no specific distances verified). Demographics for ZIP 33437: population 37,229 (Census Reporter); median age, median household income, and owner-occupancy % could not be extracted from the page (content truncated). No specific distances to nearest shopping, grocery, library, hospital, or school verified - generic hospital-finder tools and an unread hoabulletinboard schools page were the only candidates found. Open questions: (1) exact current HOA fee schedule and whether any CDD/special assessments exist; (2) ZIP 33437 median age, median household income, owner-occupancy % (Census Reporter page returned only population); (3) distances to nearest hospital (e.g., in Boynton Beach/West Palm Beach), library (Boynton Beach Public Library), grocery, and schools; (4) clubhouse renovation completion status; (5) whether the $1,665 capital contribution is still in effect at closing. Budget note: 4 of 5 searches and 5 of 5 page reads used; censusreporter.org/profiles/86000US33437-33437/ read twice (plain + JS) both returned only header stats. Recommend follow-up: read hoabulletinboard.com/hoa/clbbfl/schools/ and a Census Reporter ACS page for 33437, plus the official HOA budget presentation (Oct 2026) for current dues. Sources: cascadelakeshoa.net/home (news only), palmbeachcountyhomeforsale.com/blog/cascade-lakes-boynton-beach (amenities, pricing, gate), hoabulletinboard.com/hoa/clbbfl/about_hoa (fees, pet policy, security, rules), censusreporter.org 33437 profile (population).
